fn add(name: &str, models: &[&str]) -> ProviderOp {
    ProviderOp::Add {
        api_key_stdin: false,
        name: name.to_string(),
        kind: "openai-compatible".to_string(),
        base_url: "https://provider.example/v1".to_string(),
        model: models.first().map(|model| (*model).to_string()),
        models: models.iter().map(|model| (*model).to_string()).collect(),
        supported_clients: vec!["opencode".to_string()],
        api_key: Some("provider-key".to_string()),
        api_key_env: None,
        subscriber_id: None,
        acknowledge_intermediary_risk: false,
        acknowledge_unsupported_client: vec![],
        enabled: true,
        if_absent: false,
        target: AuthTarget::default(),
    }
}
